basic_details.scholarship_name: Cornell University Graduate Assistantship in Computer Science
basic_details.offering_entity: Cornell Ann S. Bowers College of Computing and Information Science, Cornell University (Ithaca, NY, USA - Ivy League)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Cornell University (Ithaca Main Campus & Cornell Tech, New York City, USA)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Doctor of Philosophy (Ph.D.) in Computer Science across all research fields: Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computer Systems & Networking, Theory of Computation, Scientific Computing, Programming Languages, Robotics, Natural Language Processing, and Computer Vision.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~100% of all admitted Ph.D. students receive full guaranteed financial support (~40 to 50 new fully funded PhD students admitted annually)
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open global merit competition; Pakistani students with first-class research records compete directly (typically 2 to 4 admitted with full funding/yr)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Full 5 years of guaranteed PhD funding (tuition, 12-month living stipend, and health insurance) subject to satisfactory progress

nationality_requirements: Open to international applicants from all countries worldwide
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Completed 4-year Bachelor's degree (16 years education) or Master's degree (18 years education) in Computer Science, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, or related STEM field with exceptional academic record (minimum 3.80 / 4.00 CGPA or top 5% of class from recognized Pakistani universities like LUMS, NUST, FAST-NUCES, GIKI, QAU, UET).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: First-class honors required; GPA 3.85+ is competitive among international applicant pool.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Advanced preparation in algorithms, discrete mathematics, computer systems, and theoretical foundations.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or currently in final semester of degree graduating before August intake.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Peer-reviewed research publications in top-tier conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, CVPR, OSDI, SOSP, STOC, FOCS, PLDI) provide a decisive competitive edge.

english_proficiency.notes: TOEFL iBT min 77 (Writing 20, Listening 15, Reading 20, Speaking 22) or IELTS Academic min 7.0 overall.

eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Elite doctoral researchers in computer science and artificial intelligence.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: External fellowships (e.g., Google PhD Fellowship) may supplement but do not replace departmental funding guarantee.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition waiver provided for all 5 years of doctoral study ($29,500/year waived completely).

admission_application_fee.details: Cornell Graduate School application fee ($105) paid by applicant (fee waivers available for demonstrated financial hardship upon request).

accommodation.details: Paid out of living stipend; on-campus graduate housing (Hasbrouck Apartments) or private housing in Ithaca (~$750 to $1,100/month).

monthly_stipend.details: Full 12-month living stipend: 9-month academic year stipend (~$35,000 to $39,000) PLUS guaranteed summer research support (~$8,000 to $10,000). Total living support is ~$43,000 to $48,000 / year (~$3,600 to $4,000 / month; ~PKR 1,000,000 to 1,110,000 / month).

airfare.details: Travel expenses to Ithaca/New York are self-funded.

visa_fee.details: US F-1 Visa application fee ($185) and SEVIS I-901 fee ($350) paid to US Department of State.

health_insurance.details: Full individual coverage under the Cornell Student Health Plan (SHP) is completely paid by the university for all funded PhD students ($3,600/year value).

food_allowance.details: Living expenses and meals covered by monthly stipend.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Bill & Melinda Gates Hall provides state-of-the-art workstations, computing clusters, and departmental library access.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Departmental travel grants and faculty research accounts fully cover travel, hotel, and registration for top-tier conference presentations.

travel_transit_allowance.details: All Cornell students receive free unlimited transit on TCAT buses across Ithaca and Tompkins County using their Cornell ID card.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single institution (Cornell University, Ithaca, NY - Ivy League, Top 5 CS in USA, QS World Rank #16)
participating_institutions: Cornell University (Bowers College of Computing and Information Science, Gates Hall, Ithaca & Cornell Tech NYC)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Ivy League institution; US News #5 in Computer Science, world-renowned for Theory, Systems, Programming Languages, and AI.
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's degree with 3.8+ GPA, evidence of research capability or published papers, Statement of Purpose, 3 recommendation letters from research mentors, and English test score.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Every admitted PhD student is 100% fully funded; admission is among the most selective in the world (acceptance rate ~4-5%).
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Faculty review is deeply decentralized. In your Statement of Purpose, focus on 2-3 specific research questions you want to solve and name the faculty members whose published work relates to those questions.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Cornell Graduate School Online Admissions Portal (ApplyWeb)
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Create an account on the ApplyWeb portal, select 'Computer Science - PhD', and submit your application dossier before the December 15 deadline.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Explore faculty profiles and recent papers in the Bowers College of CIS.
Step 2: Create an account on the Cornell Graduate School ApplyWeb portal.
Step 3: Complete academic history and upload unofficial transcripts for all collegiate degrees.
Step 4: Upload your Statement of Purpose (highlighting specific research interests and faculty matches).
Step 5: Upload your Academic Statement and Personal Statement (addressing diversity, perseverance, and character).
Step 6: Register 3 academic recommenders who will submit confidential reference letters online.
Step 7: Upload your CV and any published research papers or preprint links.
Step 8: Pay the $105 application fee (or apply for a fee waiver) and submit before December 15.
Step 9: Faculty admissions committee conducts comprehensive file reviews and interviews in January.
Step 10: Receive official offer letter (including 5-year full funding guarantee) in February/March; accept by April 15.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: 100% integrated: admission to the PhD program automatically carries the 5-year full fellowship/assistantship funding guarantee.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Three confidential letters of recommendation submitted online through ApplyWeb.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of Purpose: Describe your intellectual interests, research experience, and why Cornell CS is the right fit. Personal Statement: Discuss how your personal background and life experiences influenced your decision to pursue a graduate degree.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Embedded in Statement of Purpose; outline research questions, methodologies, and technical interests.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Academic CV detailing publications, research presentations, technical projects, awards, and programming expertise.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Informal technical interview (30 minutes via Zoom) conducted by prospective faculty advisors in January/February.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: GRE General is NOT required and NOT accepted for CS PhD. TOEFL iBT (min 77) or IELTS Academic (min 7.0).
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Scanned unofficial transcripts uploaded at application; official attested transcripts required upon admission.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translations for all non-English documents.

important_dates_timeline.application_deadline: 15 December (Strict PhD deadline for Fall admission)
important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: One annual intake cycle closing on 15 December for admission in the subsequent Fall semester.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 30% (Undergraduate/Master's GPA and coursework rigor in advanced mathematics and systems)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 40% (Track record of independent research, publications, and technical innovation)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (Clarity, depth, and originality of Statement of Purpose)
selection_process_and_weights.recommendations_weight: 10% (Strong, credible endorsements from established research mentors)
selection_process_and_weights.interview_weight: Decisive during advisor review for candidate ranking
selection_process_and_weights.test_scores_weight: Threshold requirement (TOEFL/IELTS compliance; GRE not used)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Cornell CS Graduate Admissions Committee comprising senior faculty from systems, AI, theory, and robotics.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Holistic, research-centric review. The committee prioritizes evidence of independent research potential (published papers, research projects, and strong faculty recommendations) alongside superior academic coursework. All admitted PhD students receive a 5-year full funding guarantee.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~2,500 to 3,000 elite international applicants compete for Cornell CS PhD seats
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~40 to 50 fully funded PhD offers made annually
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~2% to 3% (Achievable for top 2% graduates from LUMS, NUST, FAST with published research)
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: 3.85+ / 4.00 CGPA (85%+ aggregate) with at least 1-2 published papers or preprints
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates of leading institutions with substantial research contributions in machine learning, systems, or algorithms, and glowing letters from recognized researchers.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates in Computer Science, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, and Physics.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: USA, China, India, Pakistan, Canada, South Korea, Germany.

fake_websites_and_scams: Scam agencies claiming they can guarantee admission to Cornell CS. Admissions decisions are made solely by Cornell faculty committees.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Cornell application fee is $105. Eligible international students can request fee waivers directly on the application form for financial hardship.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Do not hire agents. Writing your own Statement of Purpose is essential for conveying your research vision.
hidden_costs_breakdown: US F-1 Visa fee ($185) and SEVIS fee ($350).
Flight tickets between Pakistan and New York (JFK/EWR) plus bus to Ithaca (Campus-to-Campus or OurBus ~$50 - $70).
Winter clothing for upstate New York winters (~$400 - $600).
Initial apartment security deposit (~$800 - $1,200) prior to first stipend deposit.
misleading_claims_debunked: CLAIM: GRE General score is required. (FACT: Cornell CS PhD does NOT require and does NOT accept GRE scores).
CLAIM: You must secure funding separately after admission. (FACT: All admitted PhD students receive a 5-year full funding guarantee automatically).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Third-party sites frequently list out-of-date 9-month stipend figures; Cornell CS officially provides guaranteed 12-month support including summer funding.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain satisfactory academic performance (minimum B grade / 3.00 GPA) and pass the Admission to Candidacy Examination ('A Exam') by the end of Year 3.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical research and teaching residency in Ithaca or Cornell Tech in NYC.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual progress report evaluated by the Special Committee (advisor and minor members).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Under US F-1 visa regulations, paid employment is restricted to 20 hours/week on campus during semesters.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None. F-1 STEM graduates are eligible for 36 months of Optional Practical Training (OPT) in the United States post-graduation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: None; scholars fulfill standard graduate research or teaching assistantship duties (typically 15-20 hours/week).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Funding terminates upon withdrawal; no clawback of past disbursed stipend or tuition.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Requires approval from the Director of Graduate Studies.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Funding is guaranteed for 5 years; extensions beyond Year 5 are commonly funded through faculty research grants.
